name: Filter driers & accumulators
description: Keep moisture, dirt and liquid refrigerant away from the compressor.
long_description: Filter driers trap moisture, acid and debris in the refrigerant, and should be replaced whenever the system is opened for repair. Suction accumulators stop liquid refrigerant from reaching the compressor. Both protect the compressor from early failure.

parts.name: Filter driers
parts.detail: Liquid line and suction line driers in flare and solder types.

parts.name: Suction accumulators
parts.detail: Protect the compressor from liquid refrigerant at start-up.

signs: Frost or a temperature drop across the drier
System opened for a leak or compressor repair
